LanguageData.BOR_Kylar_Xar_Computer.label: Kylar-Xar effect computer
LanguageData.BOR_Kylar_Xar_Computer.description: Miniaturization has its limits. By harnessing the Kylar-Xar effect, we can develop a revolutionary computing architecture to tackle computational challenges beyond the reach of standard processors. Only one project can be researched at a time.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Analyzer_I.label: solar analyzer
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Analyzer_I.description: Build a solar analyzer, which models this world's sun to aid research and unlock solar-tier research projects. Reverse-engineer the secrets of Solar Republic society through the study of heliophysics.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Analyzer_I.discoveredLetter:
In walking the footsteps of the original Solarites, you have learned the secrets of sunsteel. A crude method of manufacturing your own sunsteel is now available at your smelters, smithies, and fabrication benches. These facilities are not properly equipped to perform this process, and using them to produce sunsteel is rather inefficient.
Once you have enough, it is recommended that you use your sunsteel to construct the Sun Forge, a crafting apparatus that specializes in Sunsteel manufacture.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Production_I.label: nuclear metallurgy
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Production_I.description: Produce sunsteel from plasteel, gold, and uranium at a smelter. Build the sunsteel shaper to form sunsteel into solarite buildings and weapons.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Power_I.label: solar energy
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Power_I.description: Generate power the way Solarites do: splitting their sunsteel in a specially-tooled reactor. Craft Solarite fuel rods for use in the Solarite reactor.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Battery_I.label: solar battery
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Battery_I.description: Build stronger batteries from sunsteel to hold greater amounts of power.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Quarks_I.label: strong force manipulation
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Quarks_I.description: Harness the strong nuclear force to stitch neutrons into the ultra-dense Neutronium. You can already control the electromagnetic force with the literal flick of a switch; why stop at mastery over one fundamental force? Imagine - a neutron star in your own backyard!
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Quarks_I.discoveredLetterTe: Neutronosynthesis, ("n-synthesis"), is the process of turning stuff into neutronium, storing it, then turning it into better stuff. Most of the neutronium used in final products is lost to radiation, making n-synthesis a rather wasteful process. N-synthesis requires special infrastructure - refineries, synthesizers, storage, and pipes - made from materials at least as strong as sunsteel. Some high-tech items are only possible through n-synthesis. Improperly storing neutronium can be catastrophic; the decompression alone is enough to level entire cities.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Armor_I.label: solar armor
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Armor_I.description: Manufacture power armor typical of Solarite military personnel.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_JetArmor_I.label: solar jet armor
LanguageData.BOR_Research_JetArmor_I.description: Develop Daedalus-pattern jump-capable armor systems with integrated fuel-fed thrust packs.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Weapons_I.label: solar weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Weapons_I.description: Build weapons that exploit the inherent instability of sunsteel for ease-of-use, efficiency, and extreme violence.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Medicine_I.label: solar medicine production
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Medicine_I.description: Produce medicinal products on-par with Solarite nation-states at the Solar medical fabricator.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Bionics_I.label: solar bionics
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Bionics_I.description: Build Solarite body parts to replace missing appendages and organs or supplant natural flesh. Requires nanoclusters and a skilled doctor to attach.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Drugs_I.label: solar drug production
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Drugs_I.description:
Produce drugs found among Solarite communities.
Aegis is a powerful disease prevention drug that blocks many common ailments - including infection - before they are contracted, more so than penoxycyline.
Sunlite is a euphoria-inducing drink refined from sunweave. While it reduces the need for rest and suppresses pain, it is extremely addictive, albeit less so than psychite-based drugs.
Trot is a synthetic combat drug used by Solarite militaries to improve shooting, melee, and movement while dulling pain in the user.
Wide-a-wake is a productivity-enhancement drug which significantly reduces the users need to sleep.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Joy_I.label: solar recreation
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Joy_I.description: Match your technological prowess with the equivalent recreational facilities. After all, all work and no play makes Jack a dull boy.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Storage_I.label: solar adaptive storage
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Storage_I.description: Design adaptive storage systems that reconfigure their containment profile around stored materials to maximize usable space.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Hydroponics_I.label: solar hydroponics
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Hydroponics_I.description: Build sunsteel hydroponics basins to better cultivate crops indoors.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_I.label: basic n-synthesis
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_I.description: Unlocks the ability to build a neutronium extractor. Through induced beta-decay, the extractor can shift neutronium into any element, in any configuration.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarGaussWeaponry.label: solar gauss weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_SolarGaussWeaponry.description: Develop electromagnetic gauss weapons that accelerate sunsteel projectiles to extreme velocities for devastating kinetic impact.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarGaussSpecialistWeaponry.label: solar gauss specialist weapons
LanguageData.BOR_SolarGaussSpecialistWeaponry.descrip: Craft specialized gauss weapons optimized for precision marksmanship and surgical strikes against priority targets.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarGaussHighCaliberWeaponry.label: solar gauss heavy weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_SolarGaussHighCaliberWeaponry.descri: Engineer heavy gauss weapons capable of firing larger projectiles with apocalyptic force, useful for destroying fortified positions and heavy armor.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBeamWeaponry.label: solar beam weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBeamWeaponry.description: Develop sealed-emitter beam weapons engineered for space assault operations. Producing no chemical propellant byproducts, these weapons are safe to operate aboard vacuum-sealed spacecraft and ideal for anti-mechanoid engagements in the void.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBeamSpecialistWeaponry.label: solar beam specialist weapons
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBeamSpecialistWeaponry.descript: Engineer precision and close-quarters beam weapons optimized for specialist space assault roles, including designated marksman and corridor-clearing configurations for anti-mechanoid operations aboard spacecraft.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBeamHeavyWeaponry.label: solar beam heavy weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBeamHeavyWeaponry.description: Develop heavy-class beam weapons capable of sustained suppressive fire and extreme-range precision for large-scale anti-mechanoid operations in vacuum environments.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Analyzer_II.label: quasaric analyzer
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Analyzer_II.description: Build a quasaric analyzer, which simulates the quasi-stellar object at the center of your galaxy to aid research and unlock kwazaari-tier research projects. The Kwazaari will enjoy their monopoly no longer.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Analyzer_II.discoveredLette: You are now able to inefficiently forge Quasar Alloy. Recipes for it can be found at the Sunsteel Shaper.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Production_II.label: accretic condenser
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Production_II.description: Produce kwazaari alloy from sunsteel, gold, and uranium at a sunsteel shaper. Build the neutronium refabricator and theta forge to craft kwazaari alloy products. Craft Kwazaari universal parts, uniquely-tooled components for most kwazaari buildings.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Power_II.label: kwazaari energy
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Power_II.description: Generate power in amounts fit to compete with the Kwazaari Corporation themselves. Build a neutronium reactor to exploit the unique interaction between dissoluted neutronium and the permittivity of kwazaari alloy.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Battery_II.label: kwazaari battery
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Battery_II.description: Build stronger batteries from kwazaari alloy to hold ever-greater amounts of power.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Armor_II.label: kwazaari armor
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Armor_II.description: Manufacture power armor typical of Kwazaari private military contractors.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Weapons_II.label: kwazaari weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Weapons_II.description: Craft kwazaari weapons that utilize the superior properties of kwazaari alloy to secure greater profits at any cost
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarGaussWeaponry.label: kwazaari gauss weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarGaussWeaponry.description: Develop advanced gauss weapons that evolve earlier solarite prototypes into full-production kwazaari systems, accelerating kwazaari alloy projectiles at extreme velocity.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarGaussSpecialistWeaponry.label: kwazaari gauss specialist weapons
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarGaussSpecialistWeaponry.descri: Refine specialist kwazaari gauss variants for precision marksman and close-assault roles beyond the capabilities of first-generation solarite platforms.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarGaussHighCaliberWeaponry.label: kwazaari gauss heavy weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarGaussHighCaliberWeaponry.descr: Engineer heavy kwazaari gauss systems that upscale proven prototype architectures into sustained high-caliber anti-armor and suppressive platforms.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBeamWeaponry.label: kwazaari beam weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBeamWeaponry.description: Advance beam weapon engineering from solarite prototype emitters into robust kwazaari-grade plasma-beam systems optimized for high-energy combat roles.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBeamSpecialistWeaponry.label: kwazaari beam specialist weapons
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBeamSpecialistWeaponry.descrip: Develop specialist kwazaari beam variants for precision and close-quarters combat, refining lessons learned from earlier solarite specialist prototypes.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBeamHeavyWeaponry.label: kwazaari beam heavy weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBeamHeavyWeaponry.description: Scale beam technology into heavy kwazaari platforms delivering sustained suppressive output and long-range precision from matured prototype concepts.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Medicine_II.label: kwazaari medicine production
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Medicine_II.description: Produce medical items common to Kwazaari Quiklinic-brand private healthcare facilities.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Bionics_II.label: kwazaari bionics
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Bionics_II.description: Build Kwazaari body parts to replace missing appendages and organs or supplant natural flesh. Requires picoclusters and a skilled doctor to attach.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Drugs_II.label: kwazaari drug production
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Drugs_II.description:
Produce drugs found among Kwazaari employees and corpo-slaves alike.
Castra is a powerful disease prevention drug that blocks many common ailments - including infection - before they are contracted, more so than Aegis.
Sunlight is a euphoria-inducing drink refined from sunweave. While it reduces the need for rest and suppresses pain, it is addictive, albeit less so than sunlite.
Canter is a synthetic combat drug used by Solarite militaries to improve shooting, melee, and movement while dulling pain in the user.
Sleepquitin is a productivity-enhancement drug which almost removes the users need to sleep.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Joy_II.label: kwazaari recreation
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Joy_II.description: Build recreational facilities comparable to those of Kwazaari C-suite executives. Lucky!
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Storage_II.label: kwazaari adaptive storage
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Storage_II.description: Advance adaptive storage with kwazaari-alloy field regulators to improve stability and increase packing density.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Hydroponics_II.label: kwazaari hydroponics
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Hydroponics_II.description: Build the superior hydroponics system from kwazaari alloy.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_II.label: standard n-synthesis
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_II.description: Unlocks improved neutronium extractor construction using kwazaari alloy and Kwazaari universal parts, reducing neutronium loss during synthesis and enabling much more efficient neutronosynthesis recipes.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Analyzer_III.label: galactic analyzer
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Analyzer_III.description: Build a dark mirror, an extreme astronomical device that scrutinizes interstellar space for insights into dark matter. The dark mirror greatly aids your research and unlocks Tenebral research projects. In emulating Tenebral society you may, one day, join them.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Analyzer_III.discoveredLett: You are now able to inefficiently form tenebrite crystals. Recipes for it can be found at the neutronium refabricator.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Production_III.label: gravitic crystal shaping
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Production_III.description: Produce tenebrite, a crystalline material derived from kwazaari alloy and stray dark matter. Craft crystalline joints from tenebrite, crucial components in tenebrite products. Build tenebrite structures and craft tenebrite tools and weapons; they will be supreme to nearly all others.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Power_III.label: tenebrite energy
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Power_III.description: Build the dark reactor, which captures energy from stray, non-interacting particles to freely generate power.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Battery_III.label: tenebrite battery
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Battery_III.description: Build tenebral batteries to store supreme amounts of power.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Armor_III.label: tenebrite armor
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Armor_III.description: Fabricate tenebral power armor, a shadowy suit of armor to set your footing equal to Tenebral communes.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Weapons_III.label: tenebrite weaponry
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Weapons_III.description: Craft weapons of Mass Destruction and Mass-Destruction utilizing your new Tenebrite materials.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Medicine_III.label: tenebrite medicine production
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Medicine_III.description: Produce dark medicine, the tenebral medical fabricator, and femtoclusters: small machines that give your doctors agency in small places, needed for tenebral medical procedures.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Bionics_III.label: tenebrite bionics
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Bionics_III.description: Build tenebral body parts to supersede natural flesh. Requires femtoclusters and a skilled doctor to attach.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Drugs_III.label: tenebrite drug production
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Drugs_III.description:
Produce drugs commonly enjoyed in tenebral space communes.
Pax is a powerful disease prevention drug that blocks virtually all ailments - including infection and neurodegenerative disorders like dementia.
Crewmates are euphoria-inducing gummy candies refined from sunweave. While they reduce the need for rest and suppress pain, they are addictive, albeit less so than sunlight. Note: keep away from children!
Gallop is a synthetic combat psychedelic/steroid used by tenebral offensive units to improve shooting, melee, and movement while all-but-negating pain in the user... sometimes also used recreationally by the affluent within Tenebral Society.
Adreamoline is a productivity-enhancement drug which negates the user's need to sleep.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Joy_III.label: tenebrite recreation
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Joy_III.description: Build recreational facilities you might find in Tenebral apartments. They frequently go unused in their namesake's abode; perhaps you can make better use of them.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Storage_III.label: tenebrite adaptive storage
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Storage_III.description: Finalize adaptive storage using tenebrite phase lattices that permit safer, denser derealized bulk containment.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Hydroponics_III.label: tenebrite hydroponics
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Hydroponics_III.description: Build the superior hydroponics system from tenebrite crystals.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_III.label: high n-synthesis
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_III.description: Unlocks advanced neutronium extractor construction, further reducing neutronium loss during synthesis and providing highly efficient neutronosynthesis recipes.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_IV.label: laborless neutronium brew
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NSynth_IV.description: Construct the umbral neutronium self-sustained generator, which turns energy into neutronium and other materials.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Gate_IV.label: ultimate research gate
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Gate_IV.description: All of your technological efforts so far have been toward recreating preestablished human tech. But now, you have reached the end of rediscovery. Now is the opportunity for something yours - something new. What was once beyond your reach is now yours for the taking.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Power_IV.label: unlimited power
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Power_IV.description: Construct the umbral reactor, a source of free energy (as far as you're concerned).
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Bionics_IV.label: umbral bionics
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutProc_IV.label: self-sustaining production
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutProc_IV.description: Construct the umbral forge, which turns energy into neutronium and other materials.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_IV_Raw.label: umbral raw fabrication
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_IV_Raw.descript: Unlocks Tier 4 umbral forging recipes for base raw materials.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_IV_ChemFuel.des: Unlocks Tier 4 umbral forging recipes for chemical compounds and fuel feedstocks.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_IV_Medicine.des: Unlocks Tier 4 umbral forging recipes for medicines and restorative serums.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_IV_Food.label: umbral nutriforging
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_IV_Food.descrip: Unlocks Tier 4 umbral forging recipes for meals and edible products.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_IV_Constructs.d: Unlocks Tier 4 umbral forging recipes for advanced components and structural constructs.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_IV_Advanced.des: Unlocks Tier 4 umbral forging recipes for high-order BOR materials and lattice products.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_IV_Drugs.label: umbral psychochemistry
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_IV_Drugs.descri: Unlocks Tier 4 umbral forging recipes for recreational and performance drug compounds.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_IV_Externals.de: Unlocks Tier 4 umbral forging recipes for optional external-mod compounds and materials.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_I_Raw.label: solar raw fabrication
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_I_Raw.descripti: Unlocks Tier 1 sunforge recipes for base raw materials.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_I_ChemFuel.desc: Unlocks Tier 1 sunforge recipes for chemical compounds and fuel feedstocks.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_I_Medicine.desc: Unlocks Tier 1 sunforge recipes for medicines and restorative serums.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_I_Food.label: solar nutriforging
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_I_Food.descript: Unlocks Tier 1 sunforge recipes for meals and edible products.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_I_Constructs.de: Unlocks Tier 1 sunforge recipes for components and advanced construct parts.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_I_Externals.des: Unlocks Tier 1 sunforge recipes for optional external-mod compounds and materials.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_II_Raw.label: quasarian raw fabrication
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_II_Raw.descript: Unlocks Tier 2 theta forge recipes for base raw materials.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_II_ChemFuel.des: Unlocks Tier 2 theta forge recipes for chemical compounds and fuel feedstocks.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_II_Medicine.des: Unlocks Tier 2 theta forge recipes for medicines and restorative serums.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_II_Food.label: quasarian nutriforging
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_II_Food.descrip: Unlocks Tier 2 theta forge recipes for meals and edible products.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_II_Constructs.d: Unlocks Tier 2 theta forge recipes for components and advanced construct parts.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_II_Advanced.des: Unlocks Tier 2 theta forge recipes for high-order BOR materials and lattice products.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_II_Drugs.label: quasarian psychochemistry
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_II_Drugs.descri: Unlocks Tier 2 theta forge recipes for recreational and performance drug compounds.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_II_Externals.de: Unlocks Tier 2 theta forge recipes for optional external-mod compounds and materials.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_III_Raw.label: tenebral raw fabrication
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_III_Raw.descrip: Unlocks Tier 3 dark forge recipes for base raw materials.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_III_ChemFuel.de: Unlocks Tier 3 dark forge recipes for chemical compounds and fuel feedstocks.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_III_Medicine.de: Unlocks Tier 3 dark forge recipes for medicines and restorative serums.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_III_Food.label: tenebral nutriforging
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_III_Food.descri: Unlocks Tier 3 dark forge recipes for meals and edible products.
Unlocks Tier 3 dark forge recipes for components and advanced construct parts.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_III_Advanced.de: Unlocks Tier 3 dark forge recipes for high-order BOR materials and lattice products.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_III_Drugs.label: tenebral psychochemistry
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_III_Drugs.descr: Unlocks Tier 3 dark forge recipes for recreational and performance drug compounds.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NeutRecipes_III_Externals.d: Unlocks Tier 3 dark forge recipes for optional external-mod compounds and materials.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_DefenderTurret_I.label: solar defender turret
LanguageData.BOR_Research_DefenderTurret_I.descriptio: Adapts the defender turret concept into a compact autonomous sunsteel double-barreled defensive platform.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_RangerTurret_II.label: ranger railgun turret
LanguageData.BOR_Research_RangerTurret_II.description: Upgrades the turret concept into a long-range precision railgun platform that launches hypervelocity penetrator shells.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_PacifierTurret_III.label: pacifier suppression turret
LanguageData.BOR_Research_PacifierTurret_III.descript: Develops a compact short-range suppression turret that overwhelms intruders with a nonlethal neural pain cascade rather than conventional ballistic damage.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_JudgmentCannon_I.label: Judgment-class ship cannon
LanguageData.BOR_Research_JudgmentCannon_I.descriptio: Reverse-engineer the triple-barreled 33cm artillery used aboard Solarite warships, adapting it for ground installation. The resulting emplacement delivers three devastating shells per salvo at extreme range.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_NegotiatorArtillery_II.desc: Force-adapt a station-grade spinal artillery system for local deployment, including fabrication workflows for Cracker shells.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Core_Drill.label: Planetary Crust Exploitation
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Core_Drill.description: Sunsteel allows us to achieve what most thought impossible up until now. We can invent machines that will extract materials we need from deep beneath the planetary mantle.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Core_Drill_II.label: kwazaari crust exploitation
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Core_Drill_II.description: Refine the crust drilling concept with kwazaari-grade materials, enabling larger and more capable generators that can be worked from multiple directions at once.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Core_Drill_III.label: tenebral autonomous crust exploitation
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Core_Drill_III.description: Complete the transition to fully automated crust extraction systems driven by tenebral control logic and advanced self-regulation.
